description: 寶山第二水庫濁度資料 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 有鑒於新竹地區工商業的迅速發展、科學園區的產業欣欣向榮，吸引大量外來人口，導致公共及工業用水量與日俱增，用水的需求量早已不是寶山水庫、永和山水庫能夠承擔負荷的。 因此，為增進新竹地區水源的供應，經濟部水利署、台灣自來水公司與新竹縣政府共同興建寶山第二水庫。 寶山第二水庫於民國76年開始規劃，民國86年開始實施，至民國95年6月正式完工... Coverage: Baoshan Second Reservoir. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
